blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: Inequalities have a range of answers. Systems ask for values that make several equations true at the same time.
Multiply or divide by a negative number and the inequality sign flips.

blocks.title: Three methods
items: Graphing: find where the lines cross
Substitution: replace one letter by an expression
Elimination: add equations so a letter cancels

blocks.body: Always check your answer in both original equations.
